method: Official pages opened and substantive passages read using fetch_page. This is a bounded claim audit, not a complete audit of every historic repository edition. Official-context links do not verify household data or synthetic assumptions. Error pages were rejected, not counted as verification.

estate.title: IRS · Estate tax
estate.finding: 2026 filing threshold $15,000,000; gross estate can include cash, securities, real estate, insurance and trusts; adjusted taxable gifts affect filing; deductions and credits affect liability.

irs27.title: IRS · 2027 inflation adjustments
irs27.finding: IR-2026-133 dated November 5, 2026 explicitly states 2027 basic estate exclusion $15,480,000, 2026 $15,000,000. This is published, not a forecast.

faq.title: IRS · Estate tax FAQ
faq.finding: Form 706 generally due nine months after death; six-month filing extension; portability requires filing; nonresident noncitizens require separate rules.

boe.title: California BOE · Proposition 19
boe.finding: Transferor/transferee principal residence, eligible relationship, adjusted value limit; homeowners exemption within one year; exclusion claim within three years or before third-party transfer. Official page lists 2026/026 guidance.

allow.title: BOE · 2025 allowance notice
allow.finding: Allowance is $1,044,586 for transfers February 16, 2025 through February 15, 2027. Indexed every other year using California FHFA HPI, not general CPI.

rtc.title: California · RTC §51
rtc.finding: Factored base inflation increase capped at 2%; taxable value generally lesser of factored base and current full cash value. Temporary market reductions need not recover at only 2%.

trust.title: California · Probate Code §16061.7
trust.finding: Trustee notification triggered by specified events; generally 60 days, with awareness/vacancy exceptions. Does not itself establish all appraisal/insurance steps.

sco.title: California Controller · Estate tax
sco.finding: No California estate tax return for deaths on/after January 1, 2005; inheritance tax administered for pre-June 8, 1982 deaths.

basis.title: IRS · Inherited property basis
basis.finding: Generally date-of-death FMV basis, or elected alternate valuation where applicable; gain on sale above basis may be taxable.

trustbasis.title: IRS · Revenue Ruling 2023-2
trustbasis.finding: Bulletin synopsis expressly says §1014 adjustment generally does not apply to irrevocable grantor trust assets not included in deceased grantor gross estate.

sell.title: IRS · Topic 701
sell.finding: Home-sale exclusion up to $250,000/$500,000 if qualified; generally ownership/use two of five years; inheritance alone does not satisfy use.

rent.title: IRS · Topic 414
rent.finding: Rent taxable, deductible expenses subject to rules, depreciation, personal-use allocation, passive limitations and possible NIIT; capital improvements differ from repairs.

ftb.title: California FTB · Capital gains
ftb.finding: California has no preferential lower capital-gains rate; gains taxed as ordinary income.

insurance.title: California DOI · Residential insurance
insurance.finding: Compare coverage and premiums; official comparison tools linked. FAIR Plan limited perils and possible separate DIC coverage. No property-specific premium verified.

cpuc.title: California PUC · Customer generation
cpuc.finding: NEM bill credits differ from net billing; NBT applies to new interconnection applicants since April 15, 2023. No household cash profit established.

sf.title: SF Rent Board · 2026–27 increase
sf.finding: Covered rent-controlled units: 1.6% allowable annual increase March 1, 2026–February 28, 2027; not universal future rent growth.

taxsf.title: SF Treasurer · Secured taxes
taxsf.finding: FY2026–27 secured rate 1.18162182%; supplementals after reassessment; not a Cupertino or future rate, nor a complete parcel bill.

bill.title: California Legislature · SB 974
bill.finding: Chapter 665 approved September 27, 2026; special-needs trusts as eligible transfer medium. Enacted, not pending; household applicability unknown; no blanket Prop 19 repeal.

sec.title: SEC · Asset allocation and diversification
sec.finding: Allocation depends on time horizon and risk tolerance; diversification and rebalancing; no guaranteed return.

fdic.title: FDIC · Deposit insurance
fdic.finding: $250,000 per depositor per insured bank per ownership category; deposits aggregated within category; stocks, mutual funds, bonds not covered.

inflation.title: Federal Reserve History · Great Inflation
inflation.finding: 1965–1982 inflation regime included recessions and energy shocks; inflation exceeded 14% in 1980. Narrative context, not local property/portfolio returns.

recession.title: Federal Reserve History · Great Recession
recession.finding: National home prices approximately -30% mid-2006 to mid-2009; S&P500 price index -57% October 2007 to March 2009. Different peak/trough windows, not annual total returns or local forecasts.

cpi.title: BLS · Historical CPI-U
cpi.finding: Historical monthly and annual CPI table includes deflation and inflation; not a 50-year forecast or California statutory indexing series.
